title: Drafted — inducted into the U.S. Army
description: Larry was drafted and inducted into the U.S. Army in Los Angeles on October 28, 1963, entering service as a private (E-1). His DD-214 records the induction through a Los Angeles Selective Service local board. Family memory had placed the draft in 1964; the form puts it in late 1963.
researchNotes: Established by the DD-214 (item 18, date inducted; item 22, place of entry). The earlier 1964 estimate came from working back from the remembered September 1964 arrival in Vietnam.
